method.title: 候选：该源英语成片的连续检查发现概览遗漏的缺陷
method.trigger: 该源英语制作出现旧端点失败、费用不明及透明字层和闪白转场问题。
method.action: 保留原始错误与未知费用占位，先查账再决定调用；检查实际编码的原尺寸连续帧，记录端点成功与内容质量各自的证据。
method.failure_signature: 概览帧遗漏透明字层贯穿线和闪白接缝；旧 Pro、Flash 调用失败且费用未结清。
limitations: 仅限继承的源哈希、英语及 project 可见性；与 private 记录分组。
同一 Agent 视觉自审及外部模型音频感知，不代表人工、独立视觉或公司验收。
字体、光晕及遮挡蝴蝶结纹理仍为近似，不能将整体 pass 改写为逐项无损。
源片从13.1秒以三个末端帧补至13.2秒以容纳音频，记录称无内容裁切。
失败 Pro 和旧 Flash 的22 credits 仍为 reserved/unknown，不计作零费用。
单源返工不算独立复验；仅为 candidate，启用仍需限定范围的证据包和审查。
method.next_counterexample_test: 在该源新候选的透明字层、闪白和切镜区间逐帧寻找贯穿线及接缝，并核验补帧后的实际声音与字幕边界。

record.hypothesis: Current Flash endpoint succeeded after obsolete route failure. Preserve unknown fees and raw errors; do not repeat ambiguous paid calls. Native continuous review caught alpha strike-through and flash seams missed by overview frames.
limitations: Same-agent visual review plus external model audio perception; no human, independent visual or company acceptance.
Typeface/glow and occluded bow texture are approximations; product content, choice gestures and brand assets are preserved.
Source13.1s padded by three endpoint frames to13.2s for audio; no content cut.
Failed Pro and old Flash retain22credits reserved as unknown, not zero-cost.
record.promotion: Requires scoped evidence and developer/company review; not loaded by retrieval
record.evidence_boundary: Technical observation and hashes; raw private case is not needed to read this hypothesis. Activation requires independently packaged reviewed evidence.

activation: Developer review required; no validated rules changed
evidence_boundary: Embedded observations and source hashes only; no new video-quality acceptance or independent validation
